system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: I want to perform the following action: Perform these two different actions simultaneously: jjm_verify_otp and jjm_resolve_household_ambiguity.. my aadhaar_number is 100020003002, my village is Sample Village, my otp is dummy_otp_3755.

function.name: jjm_resolve_household_ambiguity
function.description: Resolves ambiguous household IDs or addresses. Returns possible matches. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT modify records. Fails if no matches found.

function.name: jjm_verify_otp
function.description: Verifies OTP and returns session_token. Does NOT check connection status. Fails if OTP expired or incorrect.
